title: Writing The Physics of Angels with Matthew Fox

tellings.quote: we chose the most interesting passages in in their books about angels the most relevant ones and then we discussed each short passage as a dialogue and that's what the book is really

plain: The biologist Rupert Sheldrake says that he and the theologian Matthew Fox wrote the book The Physics of Angels by picking the most interesting passages about angels from old Christian writers such as Dionysius the Areopagite, Thomas Aquinas and Hildegard of Bingen. Sheldrake, who co-wrote it, says they then "discussed each short passage as a dialogue and that's what the book is really," an attempt to bring old ideas of angels into talk with modern science.
